text: This report provides information regarding the impact of Toronto Atmospheric Fund's (TAF) programs based on the two core key performance indicators (KPIs): emission reduction potential and mobilization of financial capital. It also summarizes new approaches for impact tracking and reporting which will be advanced.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received the report (April 14, 2026) from the Vice President, Strategy and Partnerships, Toronto Atmospheric Fund, for information.
